name: Music
unparsed: Two courses in music theory, which may include one 400-level and one 500-level course, or two 500-level courses.

Two courses in music history and culture, taken in different semesters. One must be a qualifying 1000-level course (or graduate seminar). The other could be any level course, including courses below the 0100 level¹ (first-year seminars, etc.).
Two additional 1000-level (or graduate-level) courses in music theory, production, and/or history and culture.

Four additional elective courses according to student interest. May include 1.) up to four half-credit courses in performance (AMP music instruction and/or Ensemble Participation), 2.) one qualifying course outside of the department, 3.) one music course below the 0100 level¹.
